pages.text: Every machine, module and frame runs on a circuit, and each tier has its own.$(br)$(li)$(item)Basic Circuit$()$(br)$(li)$(item)Advanced Circuit$()$(br)$(li)$(item)Elite Circuit$()
Your first $(l)Basic Circuits$() come from a crafting table: copper, redstone and a gold nugget, $(l)one$() at a time. It is slow and dear on purpose: build a Fabricator as soon as you can.
pages.title: By hand
The Fabricator
pages.text: The Fabricator makes circuits from the ingredients in its $(l)three slots$(), at $(l)40 FE/t$(). Pipe $(l)Acid$() into it for the etched circuits. Any order, any slot: it finds the recipe.

$(li)$(l)2 Basic Circuits$(): 1 Copper Ingot, 2 Redstone, 1 Gold Nugget, none, 3 s$(br)$(li)$(l)Advanced Circuit$(): 2 Basic Circuits, 1 Gold Ingot, 250 mB, 5 s$(br)$(li)$(l)Elite Circuit$(): 1 Advanced Circuit, 1 Diamond, 1 Uranium Ingot, 500 mB, 8 s

The Acid comes from an $(l:generators/acid_synthesizer)Acid Synthesizer$(/l); the uranium from $(l:nuclear/uranium)uranium ore$(/l). Feed the Fabricator with hoppers, pipes or a $(l:drone_systems/modules)Transport drone$(/l) and keep your circuits stocked with the dock filter's $(l)limit$().
